key_highlights: ASX logged an $80b post-US midterms relief rally led by tech, despite late-week softening and sharp banking weakness.
Department store icon David Jones collapsed into voluntary administration following stalled landlord negotiations, impacting commercial REITs and suppliers.
RBA hawkishness persists amid sticky inflation and excess demand, dampening consumer discretionary and compounding borrowing capacity cuts.
Qantas announced fare increases and capacity cuts to offset a $1 billion surge in fuel costs, despite broader crude softness.
Junior resources saw brisk equity capital raising activity, led by gold, silver, and critical minerals exploration results.

sectors.trend: NextDC surged alongside global risk-on tech momentum post-US midterms, contrasting with tech workforce consolidation at Canva.
sectors.implications: AI infrastructure demand provides structural revenue support for established data centre operators, offsetting regional planning headwinds.

sectors.trend: Severe retail distress culminating in David Jones entering administration, leaving major suppliers unpaid.
sectors.implications: Intensifying consumer belt-tightening and debt servicing costs pose elevated earnings downgrade risks for cyclical retailers.

sectors.trend: Commercial mall landlords face immediate vacancy and re-leasing headwinds from David Jones store closures, alongside broader housing market downturn risks.
sectors.implications: Retail REIT asset valuations face write-down pressure; landlords must absorb renegotiated leases or vacant anchor tenancies.

sectors.trend: NAB shares slid significantly as net interest margin compression and rising arrears risks mount under restrictive RBA policy.
sectors.implications: Australian major banks face muted credit growth and potential loan impairment increases as mortgage borrowing capacity deteriorates.

sectors.trend: Gold capital raisings surged and exploration yielded strong drill hits, while oil prices slumped following US midterms.
sectors.implications: Gold producers benefit from attractive funding and safe-haven support, while energy producers face near-term margin pressure.

sectors.trend: Aviation operators face margin headwinds from a $1B fuel expense surge, while gig-economy platforms absorb High Court payroll tax rulings.
sectors.implications: Airlines risk demand destruction by passing fuel surcharges to consumers; transport operators face higher statutory labor costs.

key_themes: Post-US midterms equity relief rally countered by domestic macro headwinds
Retail distress and supply chain insolvency risk following David Jones collapse
Persistent inflation keeping RBA rates elevated and restricting household borrowing
Capital rotation toward gold and AI data infrastructure assets

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Retail Contagion and Mall Tenancy Fallout
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight retail REITs and discretionary suppliers exposed to department store tenancies.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Prolonged RBA Restrictive Policy & Mortgage Strain
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce exposure to retail banking majors and high-multiple consumer cyclicals.
Maintain neutral-to-underweight exposure in passenger aviation until cost pass-through stabilizes.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Statutory Contractor and Payroll Tax Liabilities
risk_assessment.mitigation: Audit service and platform holdings for employee reclassification tax exposure post-High Court ruling.

opportunities.recommendation: Accumulate AI-driven data centre infrastructure leaders.
opportunities.rationale: Structural demand for sovereign AI compute driving multi-year earnings visibility and institutional flows.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold producers and well-capitalised project developers.
opportunities.rationale: High equity financing liquidity, robust gold pricing, and positive exploration updates support sector valuations.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce holdings in retail REIT landlords exposed to David Jones tenancies.
defensive_moves.rationale: High risk of anchor lease renegotiations, increased incentives, and potential retail devaluations.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim exposure to major domestic mortgage-lending banks.
defensive_moves.rationale: NAB sharp slide highlights net interest margin compression, rising borrowing constraints, and credit risks.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Implement index-level hedging on the ASX 200.
defensive_moves.rationale: US midterms relief rally provides favorable levels to hedge against domestic macro and retail drag.

market_outlook.short_term: The ASX 200 (^AXJO) is poised for range-bound trading (8,150–8,350). Global relief post-US midterms supports risk appetite, but domestic banking softness and retail distress will constrain upside.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously neutral 6–12 month outlook. Elevated RBA cash rates, subdued GDP growth, and housing affordability strains favor defensive, non-discretionary sectors, gold, and digital infrastructure over domestic cyclicals.
key_catalysts: RBA monetary policy statement and interest rate trajectory
David Jones administration restructuring and creditor meetings
Australian quarterly CPI and labour market print
Global crude oil fluctuations and Qantas capacity/pricing adjustments
US midterm legislative fallout on global trade and tech investment

Iron ore 62% Fe CFR Qingdao and Brent crude benchmarks
Commercial retail vacancy rates and shopping centre re-leasing spreads
Major bank 90+ day mortgage arrears and net interest margin guidance
